Our Kumkumadi Night Oil is a cosmetic product and is not intended to treat or cure eczema or any other skin condition. Because you are dealing with eczema on your cheeks, we recommend consulting a dermatologist before adding any new skincare products to your routine. We also suggest doing a patch test on your inner forearm for 24 hours before first use.
